title: Sharp edge on top lip, unfinished inside. Exterior arrived with scratches on three sides.
text: Sharp edge on top lip, unfinished inside. Exterior arrived with scratches on three sides.. On the one hand, this box does exactly what it says it will do....it covers a standard size tissue box and it is the stainless steel look. It blends with my kitchen appliances and looks fine sitting on the corner of the island. As long as you don't look closely at it. It arrived with scratches and marks all over three sides. The inside of the box is rough to the touch, almost as if they forgot to finish it during production. The top, where the tissues are dispensed, has one actual sharp edge on the underside of the lip. It's not a big deal with just adults around, but when my young nieces visit, I will have to put this thing away so they don't accidentally nick themselves.
